message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the **official Canadian federal holidays that create long weekends in 2023** (i.e., holidays that fall on a Friday or a Monday, giving you a three‑day break):

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Long Weekend? | Notes |
|---------|-------------|---------------|-------|
| **Family Day** (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island) | **Monday, February 20** | ✅ | Creates a long weekend from Saturday 18 to Monday 20. |
| **Good Friday** | **Friday, April 7** | ✅ | Creates a long weekend from Friday 7 to Sunday 9. |
| **Victoria Day** | **Monday, May 22** | ✅ | Creates a long weekend from Saturday 20 to Monday 22. |
| **Labour Day** | **Monday, September 4** | ✅ | Creates a long weekend from Saturday 2 to Monday 4. |
| **Thanksgiving** | **Monday, October 9** | ✅ | Creates a long weekend from Saturday 7 to Monday 9. |
| **Remembrance Day** | **Monday, November 11** | ✅ | Creates a long weekend from Saturday 9 to Monday 11. |
| **Christmas Day** | **Monday, December 25** | ✅ | Creates a long weekend from Saturday 23 to Monday 25. |

**Holidays that don’t create a long weekend in 2023**

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Reason |
|---------|-------------|--------|
| New Year’s Day | Sunday, January 1 | Falls on a Sunday – no extra day off. |
| Canada Day | Saturday, July 1 | Falls on a Saturday – no extra day off. |
| Boxing Day | Tuesday, December 26 | Falls on a Tuesday – no extra day off. |

If you’re planning trips around provincial holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, or the various provincial “Heritage Days”), you’ll need to check each province’s holiday calendar separately. But for the federal holidays that give you a built‑in long weekend, the dates above are what you’ll want to target for your 2023 getaway planning. Happy travels!
